user.title: Firewalla MSP Setup
user.description: Configure your Firewalla integration to control firewall rules. You'll need your MSP domain and personal access token.

data_description.msp_url: Your Firewalla MSP domain (e.g., mydomain.firewalla.net or https://mydomain.firewalla.net)
data_description.access_token: Your personal access token from the Firewalla MSP account

reconfigure.title: Update Firewalla Credentials
reconfigure.description: Update your MSP domain or personal access token.

box_selection.title: Select Firewalla Box
box_selection.description: Choose which Firewalla box to manage rules for. The integration will discover all existing rules and create switch entities for each one.

data_description.box_gid: Select the Firewalla box whose rules you want to control

init.title: Firewalla Options
init.description: Configure rule filters and API polling intervals. Lower intervals mean faster updates but more API calls. If you hit rate limits (HTTP 429), increase these values.

data_description.include_filters: One filter per line. Only rules matching these filters will be shown (OR logic).
data_description.exclude_filters: One filter per line. Rules matching these filters will be hidden.
data_description.base_poll_interval: How often to call the Firewalla API (30-300s, default 45s). Each poll fetches time limit data (~5 KB). All other data types refresh at their own intervals below. A manual Refresh button is also available on the Firewalla device page.
data_description.full_rules_interval: How often to fetch all firewall rules including block/allow status, hit counts, and schedules (~55 KB). Between full refreshes, only time limit rules are fetched. (60-900s, default 300s)
data_description.devices_interval: How often to fetch device data: online/offline status, IP addresses, bandwidth usage, and activity detection (~45 KB). Increasing this reduces API calls but delays device status updates. (60-600s, default 600s)
data_description.users_cache_ttl: How long to cache user and group names before re-fetching (~2 KB). Names rarely change, so this can be high. (60-3600s, default 1800s)

pause_rule.name: Pause Rule
pause_rule.description: Pause an existing Firewalla rule while preserving it for future use.

resume_rule.name: Resume Rule
resume_rule.description: Resume a previously paused Firewalla rule.
